summary: Your SNAP food benefits need to be recertified. You must have a phone interview and send proof of your income and rent, or your benefits will stop.

deadlines.what: Phone interview with your caseworker at 10:00 AM
deadlines.sourceQuote: Your recertification interview is scheduled by telephone on October 28, 2026 at 10:00 AM.

deadlines.what: Send proof of income and rent
deadlines.sourceQuote: Verification documents must be returned by October 31, 2026, or your benefits will end.

steps: Put the interview date and time in your phone.
Make sure your phone is on and charged that morning.
Gather your pay stubs and your lease or rent receipt.
Send copies of these papers before the deadline.
If you miss the call, call your SNAP office the same day.
